newsitem.title: USA: Benchmarq files against Dallas Semi.
newsitem.headline: Benchmarq files against Dallas Semi.

text.p: Benchmarq Microelectronics Inc said on Tuesday that it has filed a declaratory judgment action against Dallas Semiconductor Corp, seeking to resolve certain allegations of patent infringement asserted against Benchmarq by Dallas Semiconductor.
Benchmarq said that this litigation was filed in the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Texas, Sherman Division.

Benchmarq said it had previously sought declaratory relief in a similar action, which was dismissed on June 25, 1996, based on Dallas Semiconductor's assurance to the court that it had not charged Benchmarq with patent infringement.
According to Benchmarq, the parties failed to reach agreement in subsequent negotiations.

Since the filing of the suit by Benchmarq in Sherman, Texas, Dallas Semiconductor has filed a lawsuit in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas, Dallas Division, alleging infringement of some of the same patents at issue in the Sherman litigation, Benchmarq said.
Benchmarq said it does not believe that it has violated any of the patents asserted by Dallas Semiconductor and that it intends to vigorously pursue its case in the Sherman court.
A Dallas Semiconductor spokesman declined to comment on the matter.
